person_made_it: Gordon's own photographs, letters and crew lists lead every page; nothing is stock.
emcee_who_is_speaking: On home the friends have the mic (the hero names them); on a night page the night and its countdown do; on a friend page the friend and their next night.
what_time_of_day_is_this_room: Each night page carries its own light: daylight for Folsom and LA28, golden hour for Portola and Gryphus, dawn for EDC, after dark for the rest.
did_the_click_pay_me: Light up a friend and their nights glow; open a night and a wristband appears; Play the tour flies a comet night by night with an odometer and who is coming; a pin lights its nights below.
works_for_the_recipient: Plain words for non-DJs, phone-first, readable with JavaScript off, calendar, maps and an I'm-in text on every night.
taught_me_something: Who Gordon shares the most nights with, where the year actually goes on a real map, how far it travels, and which photo anniversary is next.
told_me_the_truth: Passed dates never claim attendance, Foster is a maybe on EDC, made posters and the enamel pins say IMAGINED, the map names Natural Earth and its projection, miles state their method.
weakest: On a phone the road map shrinks to about 0.33x, so the pins and the SoCal loupe labels get small; a phone-specific crop of the map is the next fix. Dates beyond Portola, LA28 and F1 are still unaudited by Astra.
